about: The pre-release acceptance suite's run list (scripts/acceptance/suite.ts). Public: names, fingerprints and provenance labels only. The reviewers' expected values are sealed per program in scripts/acceptance/scenarios/<id>.enc.json (scripts/acceptance/scenarios.mjs), because the review documents and their scenario data are not public (docs/failure-patterns/README.md). A source that is not in the repository is read from the folder given with --sources (default: the owner's Desktop) and must match its sha256.

provenance: external reviewer's oracle (Python port of the demo branch, 32 cases), not SAP-executed, 14.10.2026
external CO review of v3.0.10, 12.10.2026: E01-E18 probes and its reference scenarios
external PP review of v3.0.10, 12.10.2026: E01-E08, A01-A14 and its reference scenarios
external FI review of v3.0.10, 11.10.2026: the acceptance checks and its section 5
external SD order-processing review of v3.0.10, 12.10.2026: the probes (rounding at 0.70, additive recalculation, negative PATCH, empty selection)
